verifications.claim: In March 2026, Trader Joe's and Ajinomoto Foods expanded a recall to over 9 million pounds of frozen ready-to-eat products.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Ajinomoto Foods North America Inc. has announced it is recalling around 9,885,240 pounds" (R1); "March 3 statement from Trader Joe's"; "adds nearly 10 million pounds" (R2); "expanded again to include nearly 10 million pounds of Trader Joe's Vegetable Fried Rice" (R3); "On March 3, Ajinomoto Foods recalled an additional 33.6 million pounds" but Trader Joe's products including expansions (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm March 2026 expansion by Ajinomoto with Trader Joe's involvement adding ~9-10M pounds of specified frozen products, some described as ready-to-eat.

verifications.claim: The recalled products include Chicken Fried Rice, Vegetable Fried Rice, Japanese Style Fried Rice, and Chicken Shu Mai.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Trader Joe’s Vegetable Fried Rice ... Chicken Fried Rice ... Chicken Shu Mai" (R1); "Chicken Fried Rice, Vegetable Fried Rice, Japanese Style Fried Rice and Chicken Shu Mai" (R2); "Trader Joe's Vegetable Fried Rice ... chicken fried rice ... shu mai" (R3); lists all four (R4)
verifications.reasoning: All listed products explicitly mentioned across multiple sources as part of the recall.

verifications.claim: The recall is due to potential contamination with foreign objects, specifically glass fragments.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "due to the presence of 'foreign objects.' The notice stated that the foreign object was glass" (R1); "glass varying in size from 1-3cm long and 2-4mm wide" (R2); "may contain glass fragments" (R3); "glass in the products" (R4); "may be contaminated with foreign material, 'specifically glass'" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All sources directly attribute recall to glass contamination.

verifications.claim: Chicken Fried Rice best by dates range from 03/04/2026 through 02/10/2027.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "Chicken Fried Rice ... best buy dates between March 5, 2026, and Oct. 23, 2026" (R1); "Chicken Fried Rice: Best By Dates 03/04/2026 through 02/10/2027" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly supports exact range; R1 provides contradictory narrower range ending Oct 2026.

verifications.claim: Vegetable Fried Rice best by dates range from 02/28/2026 through 11/19/2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: lists starting "2/28/2026" ... ending "11/19/2026" for Vegetable Fried Rice (R1); "Vegetable Fried Rice: Best By Dates 02/28/2026 through 11/19/2026" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Exact range matches in R1 (first/last dates listed) and R2.

verifications.claim: Japanese Style Fried Rice best by dates range from 02/28/2026 through 11/14/2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Japanese Style Fried Rice: Best By Dates 02/28/2026 through 11/14/2026" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Exact range directly stated in R2; no contradictions in other sources.

verifications.claim: Chicken Shu Mai best by dates range from 03/13/2026 through 10/23/2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Chicken Shu Mai ... best buy dates between March 5, 2026, and Oct. 23, 2026" (R1); "Chicken Shu Mai: Best By Dates 03/13/2026 through 10/23/2026" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: R2 exact match; R1 broader range encompasses claim's range with same end date.

verifications.claim: Glass fragments are 1-3 cm long and 2-4 mm wide.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "glass, measuring 1-3 cm long and 2-4 mm wide" (R1); "glass varying in size from 1-3cm long and 2-4mm wide" (R2); "fragments are 1-3 centimeters long and 2-4 millimeters wide" (R3); "glass ... ranging in size from 1-3 cm long and 2-4 mm wide" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Exact dimensions quoted across multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Products were distributed nationwide in 43 states.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "distributed in 43 states, including [list]" (R1); "across 43 states" (R2); "distributed in 43 states" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of distribution in exactly 43 states.

verifications.claim: Some products were exported to Canada and Mexico.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Select Ajinomoto products were also exported to Canada and Mexico" (R3); "to retailers in Canada" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: R3 covers both countries; R5 confirms Canada.

verifications.claim: USDA initially classified this as a Class I recall.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the USDA initially gave the recall the highest risk level, Class I" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Direct statement; other sources mention FDA Class II but do not contradict USDA initial classification.

verifications.claim: Class I recall means there is a reasonable probability of serious adverse health consequences.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Class I. This means there is a reasonable probability that eating the recalled products will cause serious, adverse health consequences or death" (R4)

verifications.claim: The recall was sparked by customer complaints.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "multiple customers reported finding glass" (R2); "after numerous consumer complaints about glass" (R3); "after receiving complaints of glass" (R4); "four customers reported finding glass" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources attribute initiation to customer complaints.

verifications.claim: The recall is believed to have originated from a vegetable source ingredient.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "a vegetable source ingredient, specifically carrots, was the likely source of the glass contamination" (R3); "the carrots in the products were the likely source of the glass contamination" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Direct attribution to vegetable ingredient (carrots) in both sources.

verifications.claim: No injuries have been officially reported to date.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "no confirmed injuries linked to the recalled products" (R3); "no injuries have been reported to date" (R4); "No injuries tied to the frozen chicken fried rice have been reported" (R5)
